newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan forex turnover rises 4.2 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan forex turnover rises 4.2 pct in August.

text.p: Average daily turnover on Taiwan's foreign exchange market rose 4.2 percent to US$4.234 billion in August from July, the central bank said on Wednesday.

Of the daily turnover, 27.1 percent was between the U.S. dollar and the yen and 16.4 percent was between the dollar and the mark. Trade between the local Taiwan dollar and foreign currencies comprised 40.2 percent of the total.
Spot trading took 65.5 percent of the total, cross-currency swaps 17.2 percent, forward trading 7.8 percent, margin trading 8.7 percent and options 0.8 percent.
Taiwan started financial derivatives trading in early 1994 as part of a broad liberalisation of its financial markets.
